name: kruskal-mst
description: Finds a Minimum Spanning Tree of an undirected weighted graph using Kruskal's algorithm and a Disjoint Set Union (DSU) helper.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to compute the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) of a weighted undirected graph, represented as a collection of edges.

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: Array of objects containing { u, v, weight } representing undirected edges.
